title: Equal constant float records are not shared in native code
summary: Native code shares equal structured constants, so `p1 == p2` is true for two equal constant pairs, but two equal constant records of floats stay two blocks. OCaml 5.4.0 shares both.
cause: `compare` in `middle_end/flambda2/terms/static_const.ml` matches `Immutable_float_block` against `Immutable_float_array` where `Immutable_float_block` is meant, so two float blocks compare as -1 and the map of shareable constants never finds one.

fix.text: Compares two `Immutable_float_block`s by their fields. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
